8.2 Environmental Externalities
The root mechanism of market failure regarding the environment is the existence of an externality.
Explanatory Detail:An externality occurs when the actions of one individual directly impact
response: Externalities occur when an individual's actions affect others without being compensated for their impact. In the tragedy of the commons, this leads to overfishing where each person's catch reduces the resource available globally. This collective harm is due to externalities caused by individual actions affecting shared resources.
